name: rad-repo
description: An Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package for repository context, typed recall, handoffs, scoped checks, and guarded Git shipping in Codex. Its opinionated model and heuristics cannot prove code or production health.

interface.shortDescription: Keep repo context, checks, handoffs, and Git work clear.
interface.longDescription: Repository context, typed recall, handoffs, scoped checks, guarded Git shipping, and optional release verification for long-lived agent work. It uses an opinionated document model and heuristics. Pre-ship checks cannot prove code quality or production health.
